description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Custom3DPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom-3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ArtistResult" name="Artist result with STL delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdatedResult" name="Updated result with STL delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status sent"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Custom3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SketchesToArtist" name="Send sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangesToArtist" name="Tell changes" sourceRef="Task_RequestChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ResultFromArtist" name="Deliver result" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatedFromArtist" name="Deliver updated result" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_UpdatedResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusFromPrinter" name="Send status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Event_StatusReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Custom 3D model desired"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ResultReceived" name="Artist result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ResultReceived" messageRef="Message_ArtistResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Result to review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewResult" name="Review result"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" name="Satisfied with result?" default="Flow_NotSatisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UpdatedResultReceived" name="Updated result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_UpdatedResultReceived" messageRef="Message_UpdatedResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock_Split" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRemaining" name="Check remaining amount of color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Remaining_Split" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_NotUnder100"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Add color to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start printer preparation and G-code generation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StatusMerge" name="Status to check"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StatusReceived" name="Printer status received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_StatusReceived" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StatusReady_Split" name="Printer ready?" default="Flow_StatusNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL file"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Printer and G-code ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Printed" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Sketches" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sketches_ResultWait" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResultWait_ReviewMerge" sourceRef="Event_ResultReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateWait_ReviewMerge" sourceRef="Event_UpdatedResultReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewMerge_Review" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_SatisfiedSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes_UpdateWait" sourceRef="Task_RequestChanges" targetRef="Event_UpdatedResultReceived"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Color_InStockSplit" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_OrderColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_RemainingSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Remaining_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Remaining_Split" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingUnder100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder100" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Remaining_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingList_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Merge" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PrepSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_TurnOn" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_Gcode" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOn_StatusMerge" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusMerge_StatusWait" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusMerge" targetRef="Event_StatusReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusWait_ReadyCheck" sourceRef="Event_StatusReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StatusReady_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusReady" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusReady_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${printerReady}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusNotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusReady_Split" targetRef="Gateway_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gcode_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepJoin_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_Printed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
